name: Retrieval Index Integrity Monitor
mechanism: Links every indexed chunk to versioned source hashes, ACL state and transformation lineage and alerts on membership drift, targeted dominance, deletion gaps and abnormal embedding distributions.
use_when: Indexes are updated continuously or by multiple pipelines
Poisoning deletion and unauthorized membership must be detected
avoid_when: The index is rebuilt as one signed immutable release with equivalent verification
Monitoring has no authoritative source manifest for comparison
expected_effects: Detectable source-to-index integrity and deletion propagation
Operational signals for targeted retrieval manipulation
failure_modes: The source manifest is compromised with the index
Embedding drift alerts on benign model migration
